aggregation.OOR: room-micro mean: sum(source mean_oor * complete_source_count) / total_complete; math.fsum; derived from stored source summaries, not rescored

legacy.six_strata_selection: Exact source and normalized room_type; living dining room is not merged into living room.
limitations: Object order and category-index assignment inherit reference footprint dimensions and pose tie-breaking from V1 canonicalization. Removing explicit size fields does not remove this target-derived information. These results do not establish performance for arbitrary object lists with unknown sizes.

The frozen SFT/DPO stage comparison remains a diagnostic comparison under that original input contract. Its inferential labels describe only the preregistered checker proxy on these cohorts; they do not establish general size-unknown deployment validity, causal benefits of cleaning alone, or physical mesh quality.

A target-independent input order requires a separately versioned data contract, rebuilt training/evaluation data and a new training protocol. Existing generated outputs and metrics are preserved; the scoring function and model recipe are not changed retrospectively.

This report is published only after independent CPU rescoring of all saved outputs with the original frozen scorer and interpreter, and verification of the DPO model training/merge lineage. Failure is reported as incomplete without inferential conclusions.

differences: dataset: paper 676 test layouts vs legacy six-strata 1009 and all-source test 8647; identical IDs not established
input: paper retrieved known asset sizes and reasoning; legacy unknown movable sizes with target-derived ordering/IDs and JSON placements
model: paper generic Qwen3-8B training; legacy inherits liantian/OptiScene-Qwen-8B-Final, author-checkpoint identity and upstream history not established; new J/P use pinned generic Qwen3-8B
render_protocol: paper Isaac Sim/GPT-4o; legacy has no measured FID/GPT; new planned Blender real-asset renders and gpt-6.1-sol differ from paper
metric: legacy unrotated XY box area OOR is conditional on complete outputs; repaired system outputs are separate; paper rotation/aggregation/failure details incompletely specified
